title: #400 Online Learning
prompt: What potential challenges do students face in online learning environments?

promptSegments.text: What potential challenges do students face in online learning environments?

requirements.en: Answer every direct question in the prompt.
requirements.vi: Trả lời mọi câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

requirements.en: State a clear and consistent position when an opinion is requested.
requirements.vi: Nêu quan điểm rõ ràng và nhất quán khi đề yêu cầu ý kiến.

requirements.en: Develop each main idea with explanation and an example.
requirements.vi: Phát triển mỗi ý chính bằng giải thích và ví dụ.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first challenge is that students must manage their own study time, which can be difficult without the routine of a physical class.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first challenge is that students must manage their own study time, which can be difficult without the routine of a physical class.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: A good solution is for schools to offer more support, such as online study groups, to help students feel less alone.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A good solution is for schools to offer more support, such as online study groups, to help students feel less alone.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The primary challenge is the requirement for strong self-discipline, as students must manage their time and study routine independently, which can lead to procrastination and difficulty staying focused.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The primary challenge is the requirement for strong self-discipline, as students must manage their time and study routine independently, which can lead to procrastination and difficulty staying focused.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: A solution is establishing structured support systems, such as regular check-ins and one-on-one tutoring, which helps maintain student engagement and connection.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A solution is establishing structured support systems, such as regular check-ins and one-on-one tutoring, which helps maintain student engagement and connection.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The primary challenge in online learning is the requirement for self-discipline and effective time management, which can lead to academic difficulties.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The primary challenge in online learning is the requirement for self-discipline and effective time management, which can lead to academic difficulties.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: A practical solution involves establishing structured support systems to combat isolation and boost student engagement.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: A practical solution involves establishing structured support systems to combat isolation and boost student engagement.

promptTraps.en: Do not write off-topic generalizations; ground every point in the specific context of Education.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết chung chung ngoài đề; hãy gắn chặt từng luận điểm vào bối cảnh cụ thể của Education.

promptTraps.en: Avoid memorized generic templates; ensure every body paragraph contains concrete reasoning and evidence.
promptTraps.vi: Tránh các câu rập khuôn học thuộc lòng; hãy đảm bảo mỗi thân bài đều có lập luận và dẫn chứng cụ thể.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh dùng các câu văn mẫu học thuộc lòng chung chung và các ý lạc đề.
